## Demo Data

The workflow follows the same logic as `Figure_1.r` in the reference repository
([brucezhou9527/hello-world, branch `Cell_Reports_Medicine_2025`](https://github.com/brucezhou9527/hello-world/tree/Cell_Reports_Medicine_2025)):

1. A per-patient senescence score (in the original: ssGSEA of `GOBP_CELLULAR_SENESCENCE`) is dichotomised into **High / Low**.
2. `survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ status)` fits the KM curves.
3. `survminer::ggsurvplot()` draws them (palette `#E93E3F` for High, `#A6CEE3` for Low, x-axis 0–24 months in steps of 6, y-axis in percent).

Because the real clinical and expression data are not public here, We simulate demo data whose group sizes, curve shapes and log-rank p-values reproduce the figure.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(survival) # Surv(), survfit(), survdiff()
library(survminer) # ggsurvplot(), surv_pvalue()
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork) # combine the two panels
library(tidyverse) # dplyr, tibble, readr

col_high <- "#E93E3F" # red
col_low <- "#A6CEE3" # light blue

# target survival curves read from the figure
target <- list(
    OS = list(
        High = list(
            t = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 18, 24),
            S = c(1, .97, .83, .69, .53, .44, .36, .30, .27, .25)
        ),
        Low = list(
            t = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 12, 14, 18, 21, 24),
            S = c(1, .98, .88, .80, .66, .58, .53, .46, .37, .36)
        )
    ),
    PFS = list(
        # steep early drop around 2-3 months (first imaging)
        High = list(
            t = c(0, 1.5, 1.9, 2.2, 2.5, 3, 5, 9, 15, 24),
            S = c(1, .97, .90, .66, .46, .33, .23, .17, .12, .11)
        ),
        Low = list(
            t = c(0, 1.5, 2, 2.3, 2.6, 3.2, 4.5, 7, 12, 18, 24),
            S = c(1, .97, .90, .70, .54, .50, .36, .30, .23, .19, .18)
        )
    )
)

# inverse of a piece-wise linear survival curve
inv_surv <- function(u, tg, tail_rate = 1 / 12) {
    f <- approxfun(rev(tg$S), rev(tg$t), ties = "ordered") # S -> t
    smin <- min(tg$S)
    tmax <- max(tg$t)
    # u below the plateau: event would happen after 24 months (will be censored)
    ifelse(u > smin, f(pmin(u, 1)), tmax + rexp(length(u), tail_rate))
}

simulate_cohort <- function(seed, n_high = 120, n_low = 88) {
    set.seed(seed)
    n <- n_high + n_low
    score <- rnorm(n, mean = 0.35, sd = 0.08) # ssGSEA-like score
    ord <- order(score)
    grp <- rep("High", n)
    grp[ord[seq_len(n_low)]] <- "Low"

    u <- runif(n) # shared by OS & PFS
    cens <- pmin(6 + rexp(n, 1 / 22), 24) # random censoring, max 24 mo

    os_lat <- pfs_lat <- numeric(n)
    for (g in c("High", "Low")) {
        i <- grp == g
        os_lat[i] <- inv_surv(u[i], target$OS[[g]])
        pfs_lat[i] <- inv_surv(u[i], target$PFS[[g]])
    }

    data.frame(
        patient_id = sprintf("P%03d", seq_len(n)),
        CANCER_TYPE = "mUC",
        GOBP_CELLULAR_SENESCENCE = round(score, 6),
        OS_MONTHS = round(pmin(os_lat, cens), 2),
        OS_CNSR_REV = as.integer(os_lat <= cens), # 1 = death observed
        PFS_MONTHS = round(pmin(pfs_lat, cens), 2),
        PFS_CNSR_REV = as.integer(pfs_lat <= cens) # 1 = progression/death
    )
}

demo <- simulate_cohort(seed = 1967) |> as_tibble()

# write.csv(demo, "demo_survival_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
head(demo)
```

## Dichotomise the score

Same logic as `Figure_1.r` (`status <- ifelse(score > cutoff, "High", "Low")`), but with a fixed cut-point that gives 120 / 88 patients.
To use a data-driven optimal cut-point instead, replace `cutoff` with the result of `survminer::surv_cutpoint()` (see the commented lines).

```{r}
#| label: dichotomise
km_data <- subset(demo, CANCER_TYPE == "mUC")

sorted <- sort(km_data$GOBP_CELLULAR_SENESCENCE)

# 88 lowest scores -> "Low"
cutoff <- mean(sorted[88:89])

# as in Figure_1.r
# cutoff <- median(km_data$GOBP_CELLULAR_SENESCENCE)
# cp <- surv_cutpoint(km_data, "OS_MONTHS", "OS_CNSR_REV", "GOBP_CELLULAR_SENESCENCE")
# cutoff <- cp$cutpoint$cutpoint                                # optimal cut-point

km_data$status <- factor(
    ifelse(km_data$GOBP_CELLULAR_SENESCENCE > cutoff, "High", "Low"),
    levels = c("High", "Low")
)
table(km_data$status)
```

## Kaplan–Meier Fits

```{r}
#| label: fit
fit_os <- survfit(Surv(OS_MONTHS, OS_CNSR_REV) ~ status, data = km_data)
fit_pfs <- survfit(Surv(PFS_MONTHS, PFS_CNSR_REV) ~ status, data = km_data)

# log-rank tests
p_os <- surv_pvalue(fit_os, data = km_data)$pval
p_pfs <- surv_pvalue(fit_pfs, data = km_data)$pval
c(OS = p_os, PFS = p_pfs)
```

## Survival Plots

`ggsurvplot()` supplies the curves, the censor ticks and the percent axis.
Everything else that makes the figure look like the original is added with `ggplot2`:

* a plain `theme_classic()` (only left and bottom axis lines),
* the p-value as a text annotation (not the default `pval = TRUE` position),
* a **hand-drawn legend** (hollow coloured squares + text, with the title *Cellular Senescence Score*), placed in data coordinates; `clip = "off"` lets it sit on the axis edge.

```{r}
#| label: plot-fun
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-cap: "Kaplan–Meier curves of overall survival (left) and progression-free survival (right) by Cellular Senescence Score (demo data)."
km_panel <- function(fit, data, ylab, pval, p_xy, leg) {
    # leg: list(tx, ty, ey, hx, lx)  title x/y, entry y, High x, Low x
    g <- ggsurvplot(
        fit,
        data = data,
        surv.scale = "percent",
        break.time.by = 6,
        xlim = c(0, 24),
        linewidth = 0.9,
        censor.shape = "+",
        censor.size = 2.6,
        linetype = c(1, 1),
        palette = c(col_high, col_low),
        xlab = "Months after ICB",
        ylab = ylab,
        pval = FALSE,
        conf.int = FALSE,
        legend = "none",
        ggtheme = theme_classic(base_size = 12)
    )$plot

    n_h <- sum(data$status == "High")
    n_l <- sum(data$status == "Low")
    bw <- 1.1
    bh <- 0.065 # legend box width / height

    g +
        coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 24), ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
        scale_x_continuous(
            breaks = seq(0, 24, 6),
            expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
        ) +
        annotate(
            "text",
            x = p_xy[1],
            y = p_xy[2],
            hjust = 0,
            size = 4.6,
            label = sprintf("p = %s", pval)
        ) +
        # legend title
        annotate(
            "text",
            x = leg$tx,
            y = leg$ty,
            hjust = 0,
            size = 4,
            label = "Cellular Senescence Score"
        ) +
        # High
        annotate(
            "rect",
            xmin = leg$hx,
            xmax = leg$hx + bw,
            ymin = leg$ey - bh / 2,
            ymax = leg$ey + bh / 2,
            fill = NA,
            colour = col_high,
            linewidth = 0.8
        ) +
        annotate(
            "text",
            x = leg$hx + bw + 0.3,
            y = leg$ey,
            hjust = 0,
            size = 3.6,
            label = sprintf("High (n=%d)", n_h)
        ) +
        # Low
        annotate(
            "rect",
            xmin = leg$lx,
            xmax = leg$lx + bw,
            ymin = leg$ey - bh / 2,
            ymax = leg$ey + bh / 2,
            fill = NA,
            colour = col_low,
            linewidth = 0.8
        ) +
        annotate(
            "text",
            x = leg$lx + bw + 0.3,
            y = leg$ey,
            hjust = 0,
            size = 3.6,
            label = sprintf("Low (n=%d)", n_l)
        ) +
        theme(
            axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
            axis.title = element_text(colour = "black"),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")
        )
}

fmt_p <- function(p) formatC(p, digits = if (p < 0.01) 3 else 3, format = "g")

g_os <- km_panel(
    fit_os,
    km_data,
    "Overall survival probability",
    fmt_p(round(p_os, 3)),
    p_xy = c(9.7, 0.79),
    leg = list(tx = 1.4, ty = 0.19, ey = 0.05, hx = -0.3, lx = 10.5)
)

g_pfs <- km_panel(
    fit_pfs,
    km_data,
    "Progression-free survival",
    fmt_p(round(p_pfs, 3)),
    p_xy = c(4.8, 0.85),
    leg = list(tx = 6.4, ty = 0.57, ey = 0.44, hx = 4.9, lx = 15.6)
)

g_os | g_pfs

# fig <- (g_os | g_pfs)
```
